problems: Cliopatria's two Croatia shapes are not nested: the 1992 shape contains about 5,800 km2 of Bosnia and Herzegovina and the Knin area; the 1996 shape contains Eastern Slavonia two years before its January 1998 return (both corrected in the dossier).

Cliopatria 'Estonia' 1919-1939 and 'Republic of Estonia' 1992-2024 share one polygon (48,568.9 km2) that equals modern Estonia in the gazetteer, so the interwar row lacks Pechory and the Narva east bank (owner of the estonia dossier should check). Treated as two dossiers of one state in law (Estonian SSR between); estonia is a predecessor.
republic-of-croatia used 3 pages against a 1-2 budget (the Krajina page was needed for the 1995 and 1998 border moves).

WebFetch returns a small model's extract, not the page text; ambiguous extracts (Ten-Day War border crossings, 2022 staging from Belarus, exact Flash and Storm days) were not quoted or were left undated.
